name: Local inference
description: Model acquisition/update separated from running already-downloaded artifacts. Inference stays local.

modules.name: Run downloaded models (loopback only)
modules.rationale: Client/server on loopback; no external network during inference.
modules.expected_breakage_if_omitted: the client cannot reach the local server.
test_recipe: moat-launch --profile local-inference -- ollama run <model> 'hi'  # expect an answer
moat-launch --profile local-inference -- curl -sS https://example.com  # expect refusal

modules.name: Model download and update (time-limited)
modules.rationale: Registry access only inside the separate model-install profile, so inference never keeps a download lease.
modules.expected_breakage_if_omitted: ollama pull fails; already-downloaded models still run.
test_recipe: moat-launch --profile model-install -- ollama pull <small model>  # expect success
end the session; moat-launch --profile local-inference -- ollama pull <model>  # expect refusal (no leftover download lease)
